## Most overdue open work order

**WO-2026-00047** — Battery Tray Base Pan (formed), qty 120, make-to-stock, status *stopped*, planned end 2026-02-25, **238 days past due** (today 2026-10-21). Nothing produced yet (0 of 120).

### Why it is late
- **Blocking:** the subcontract has not been sent. **SCO-2026-00038** is still in *draft* (vendor Rajendra Naik, expected delivery 2026-03-03). Because that has no known ready date, the order cannot be given a committable finish date — `projected_finish` is null.
- Contributing: the order is **stopped with no recorded reason**; it is stuck at operation 1, **Laser Cut Blank, JC-2026-00139** on LASER-01 Trumpf TruLaser 3030 — never started, 247 days waiting. The two later cards are also open and unstarted: **JC-2026-00140** (Deburr & Edge Break, ASSY-01) and **JC-2026-00141** (Press Brake Form Pan, PB-01).
- Recorded downtime on the route: **PB-02 Energy Mac 100T**, quality_issue, 202.21 min (2025-09-20 → 2025-09-27, "Spring steel strip: line 314 at Aurangabad. Accepted on concession."); **PB-01 Amada HFE 1303**, 417.37 min across 2 setup_change entries since 2026-07-23; **ASSY-01**, 45 min, 1 tool_change entry. Schedule capacity ceilings are recorded on **WS-2026-00009** (480 min) and **WS-2026-00001** (720 min).
- Cost: expected and actual are both 0 — no cost has been recorded, so no variance is computed.

### What it blocks
Downstream work orders are **potential** consumers found by BOM matching (they *may* be affected, not confirmed blocked): WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00071, WO-2026-00056 (all Battery Tray Weldment sub-assy), and one level further WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076, WO-2026-00061 (EV Battery Tray Assembly 2400).

Sales orders reachable only through those potential consumers (potential exposure), all Bharat EV Motors Ltd:
- SO-2026-00021 — due 2026-08-18, ₹456,695.40 (undelivered)
- SO-2026-00171 — due 2026-07-12, ₹2,219,635.79 (undelivered)
- SO-2026-00151 — due 2026-06-10, ₹2,693,620.93 (undelivered)
- SO-2026-00050 — due 2026-09-16, ₹1,174,359.60 (already delivered)

WO-2026-00047 itself has no sales order linked (make-to-stock), so there is no directly-linked customer exposure.

### Rescheduling
**Nothing can be written.** For WO-2026-00047 the proposal gives `new_start`/`new_end` = null, reason "blocked by an event with no known date", `date_committable=false`, `writable_by_seat=false` (why: no committable date — subcontract_not_sent). The same applies to every dependant in the proposal (WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076) — all wait on it and none is writable.

This needs a person: someone must release/issue the draft subcontract SCO-2026-00038 (or confirm a real ready date) before any date can be committed. **No escalate tool is available to this seat** — I checked; only AgentEscalation.get/list are in the catalogue, so I could not raise an escalation. Please route this to whoever owns subcontract release.

### Not visible to me
Nothing on this order was outside my reach — `not_visible_to_this_seat` is empty.
